title: The Story Where the Friend Is the Hero
youtube_title: The Story Where the Friend Is the Hero | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A game is kinder when nobody has to watch from the step.
summary: At a library rug under the round window, Lumen is just outside the fun, close to a story you could retell so your friend was the hero too. Sora changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Lumen has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Grandma Nia lets the children solve it.
